summary.en: Community local LLM inference engine with a native Windows Arm64 CUDA (sm_121) build, measured by its author on an RTX Spark N1X laptop.
summary.zh-TW: 社群製作的本機 LLM 推論引擎，提供原生 Windows Arm64 CUDA（sm_121）版本，作者在 RTX Spark N1X 筆電上實測。

caveats.en: Measurements are self-reported from one HP OmniBook X; no independent verification.
caveats.zh-TW: 測量結果由作者自行回報，僅來自一台 HP OmniBook X，未經獨立驗證。

caveats.en: Community project; the release page did not show asset names, so the contents were taken from the release notes.
caveats.zh-TW: 社群專案；發行頁未顯示檔案名稱，內容以發行說明為準。
